card_name: Axis Bank My Zone Credit Card
fee_details:
* 1st year: Rs.500 ( waived on spending Rs.100,000 within 45 days)
* 2nd year onwards: Rs.500
reward_structure: No reward points are given on any transactions.
key_highlights:
* EMIs
* Fuel surcharge waiver
* Dining benefits
* Secure transactions
* Shopping benefits
* Lounge access
* Savings discount
* Song-LU
* Movie Tickets

benefits_features.EMIs: Any purchase above Rs.2,500 may use the card can be converted into easy monthly installments by contacting the bank.
benefits_features.Fuel Surcharge waiver:
Get 15% fuel surcharge waived for fuel transactions carried out at all fuel stations across India. The waiver is valid on card transactions between Rs.400 and Rs.4,000. The maximum surcharge waived is capped at Rs.100. 
Partial fuel surcharge waiver is applicable.
benefits_features.Dining: Under Axis Bank's 'My Zone' Dining programme you enjoy a minimum 15% off on dining at select restaurants in this cycle.
benefits_features.Secure: The Axis Bank My Zone Credit Card is secured by a PIN. It helps reduce the risk of theft by requiring a PIN at an ATM. This initial PIN makes more secure transactions than magnetic strip cards because the theft of counterfeit is avoided and skimming avoided.
benefits_features.Shopping: In case you spend Rs.2,999 or above Rs.1000 may be provided as a discount.
benefits_features.Lounge Access: 1 lounge access can be availed at an Indian airport per quarter at no additional charges.
benefits_features.Savings Discount: Rs. 120 is provided as a discount in advance when you create the credit card. The offer can be availed a maximum of two times in a month.
benefits_features.Song LU: Following the first spend by using the ‘Song LU’, ‘Song LU Premium Subscription’ is given free of cost.
benefits_features.Movie Tickets: In case you purchase two movie tickets on Paytm Movies, the second ticket is provided free of cost.

how_tos.Online:
Step 1: Visit the Axis Bank official website.
Step 2: In Axis Bank’s menu bar, explore ‘Explore Products’ under which ‘Cards’ is followed by ‘Credit Cards’.
Step 3: On ‘Axis Bank’s My Zone Credit Card’ from the list and then click on ‘Know More’ if you want to know more about the card; otherwise you can click on the option ‘Apply Now’. 
Step 4: On clicking on ‘Apply Now’, a new page will open.
Step 5: Follow the steps on the page; personal details will need to be entered.
Step 6: Click on the box where you authorize the bank’s representative get in touch with you regarding your application for the credit card.
Step 7: Click on ‘Call Me’; A representative from the bank will get in touch with you and will assist you with the process of applying for the credit card.
how_tos.Offline: You can visit the nearest Axis Bank branch along with all the necessary documents. A representative from the bank will help you with the process of applying for the Axis Bank My Zone Credit Card.

reward_point_benefits: No reward points are given on any transactions.

fees_and_charges.Cash withdrawal fee: 2.5% of the transaction amount or Rs.500 whichever is higher
fees_and_charges.Over limit penalty fee: 2.5% of the over limit amount or Rs.500
fees_and_charges.Rent transaction fee: 2% capped at Rs.1,500 for every transaction
fees_and_charges.Fee for foreign currency transaction:
3.5% of the total amount transacted
* Nil Total Payment Due is less than Rs.500
* Rs. 500 total payment due is between Rs.501 - Rs.5,000
* Rs. 750 total payment due is between Rs.5,001 - Rs.10,000
* Rs.1,200 total payment due is greater than Rs.10,000
fees_and_charges.Late Payment Fee: 2% of the transaction amount. Minimum Rs.400 up to Rs.1,500
fees_and_charges.Cheque return fee: 2% of the transaction amount. Minimum up to Rs.1,500

miscellaneous:
Eligibility for Axis Bank My Zone Credit Card:
People who meet the following conditions can apply for an Axis My Zone Credit Card.
•	The age of the primary cardholder must be between 18 to 70 years.
•	The applicant can be a resident of India on an NRI.

faqs.Can I earn reward points if I make fuel: No, Axis Bank My Zone Credit Card does not provide any reward points for transactions made for fuel payments, EMIs, and movie tickets. However, the cardholder can get 15% fuel surcharge waived where you can get a maximum waiver of Rs.100 per statement cycle. Having that said, this fuel surcharge waiver is applicable only to transactions made ranging from Rs.400 to Rs.4,000.
faqs.How is without/with surcharge from my Ax: Axis Bank My Zone Credit Cardholders can withdraw a specific amount of cash at any time but the bank will charge cash advance charges of 2.5% of the amount withdrawn using the credit card.
faqs.Can I apply for Axis Bank My Zone Credit: Yes, you can definitely apply Axis Bank My Zone Credit Card even if you don’t have an account in Axis Bank but you may need to meet certain eligibility criteria to avail yourself of this credit card. Usually, the other banks offer credit cards to those whose credit score is rated at least 750.
faqs.What is the foreign currency transaction: The foreign currency transaction fee charged on the Axis Bank My Zone Credit Card is 3.5% of the amount transacted. That is not a preferred credit card for making foreign currency transactions because it means high fees.
faqs.How does Axis Bank My Zone Card works?: Axis Bank Axis Bank My Zone Card provides the cardholders to get quick cash advances and cash withdrawals that the cardholders can repay later. The bank has an interval as well as other charges for its services. The card costs Axis Bank My Zone Credit Card could avoid the minimum amount every month within the due dates of every month.
faqs.How can I activate my Axis Bank My Zone: Axis Bank My Zone Credit Cardholders can also activate the PIN by visiting the nearest authorized Axis Bank ATM or by calling their customer support number 1860-419-5555. Apart from that, the PIN can also be generated visiting the official website of Axis Bank.
faqs.How long does the bank take to approve m: You would know about the decision on your application for the Axis Bank My Zone Credit Card within 21 working days from the date the bank receives your request.
faqs.What is the maximum amount of cashback t: The cashback amount on the credit card removes the surcharge capped at Rs. 100,000 per calendar year.
faqs.Will I earn reward points on the transac: No, you do not earn any reward points on card transactions with the My Zone Credit Card.
